sloka: विप्रलु प्तप्रजातस्य दुष्कृतम् ब्राह्मणस्य यत् ।तदेव प्रतिपद्येत यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः ॥२-७५-५४॥
transliteration: vipralu ptaprajātasya duṣkṛtam brāhmaṇasya yat ।tadeva pratipadyeta yasyāryo'numate gataḥ ॥2-75-54॥

translations.english: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother acquire the same sin like that of a lowbred brahmin who commits an irreversible sin acquires
